storeInfo.name: Johnny's Clam Shack
storeInfo.tagline: Coastal comfort on every plate / Confort costero en cada plato

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Bollitos de maíz fritos a la perfección en lotes pequeños, crujientes por fuera y suaves por dentro.
products.descriptionEn: Fried cornmeal bites fried to perfection in small batches, crispy on the outside and melt-in-your-mouth soft inside.

products.descriptionEs: Almejas frescas empanizadas cada mañana y fritas hasta alcanzar un dorado crujiente irresistible.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh clams hand-breaded every morning and fried to an irresistible golden crisp.
Tender calamari lightly breaded and fried, served with house-made marinara and fresh lemon.
Hand-cut French fries, golden, crispy, and seasoned with our signature spice blend.

products.nameEs: Sopa de Almejas (New England Clam Chowder)
products.descriptionEn: Classic thick and creamy clam chowder simmered low and slow with potatoes, onions, and savory spices.
Generous portion of fresh lobster meat tossed with a touch of mayo and warm butter served on a toasted split-top bun.

products.nameEs: Cesta de Pescado y Papas Fritas
products.descriptionEn: Fresh cod fillet in a crispy beer batter, served with seasoned fries, coleslaw, and house tartar sauce.
Double juicy beef patties with melted cheddar cheese, crisp lettuce, tomato, and shack sauce on a toasted brioche bun.
A mountain of fried clams, battered shrimp, fresh fish, and calamari served with fries, coleslaw, and hushpuppies.
Large jumbo shrimp hand-breaded to order, fried golden and served with zesty cocktail sauce and lemon.
Freshly squeezed lemonade made in-house daily with just the right balance of sweet and tart.
Freshly brewed black tea served ice cold with a lemon wedge.
Rotating draft craft beer from independent Connecticut breweries. Ask your server for current taps.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, pregunte a nuestro personal por las opciones marcadas en el menú o alternativas a la plancha.
faqs.aEn: Yes, please ask our staff for items marked on the menu or grilled alternatives.

faqs.qEs: ¿Aceptan reservaciones o es orden en mostrador?
faqs.qEn: Do you take reservations or is it counter service?
faqs.aEs: Funcionamos principalmente como un shack clásico al aire libre y mesas de picnic con pedido rápido en mostrador.
faqs.aEn: We operate primarily as a classic roadside shack and picnic table spot with fast counter ordering.
